project: Sakura Ishikari Data Center Existing Operations
selected_scope: Named operating-campus locator, independent of Building 3 C/D fit-out

selected_locator.precision: Approximate analyst-selected point inside the named Sakura Ishikari parent campus. It is not an operator-published pin, surveyed centroid, campus boundary, building footprint, or Building 3 C/D fit-out location.
selected_locator.identity_review: The municipal plan labels Sakura Internet Ishikari Data Center on the compound south of Minato-dori and west of the parallel main road. Its perpendicular long buildings, the circular Sun Village sports hall across Minato-dori, the northwest small compound, and the surrounding road geometry match the GSI map. The point is selected within that identified campus only.
selected_locator.uncertainty_reason: Municipal and GSI maps provide no surveyed accuracy for this analyst-selected point; map vintage and manual matching add unquantified uncertainty. Four decimal places are output to avoid implying building or survey precision.

municipal_identity_map.map_title: Sapporo metropolitan urban planning park amendment plan, existing condition map
municipal_identity_map.date_semantics: Submission date printed on cover; the map is identity and location evidence only, not a data-center permit or recent operating observation.

reference_map.projection: Web Mercator XYZ tiles; longitude and latitude derived by inverse tile projection

coordinate_calculation.selection_method: Manual visual identification of the same named campus in municipal and GSI maps; choose one interior campus point on the georeferenced GSI map. No automated registration or claimed fit residual.
coordinate_calculation.inverse_formula: longitude = global_x / world_pixel_width * 360 - 180; latitude = degrees(atan(sinh(pi * (1 - 2 * global_y / world_pixel_width))))
coordinate_calculation.pixel_origin: Upper-left of native 256-pixel tile; x rightward, y downward

distinctness_review.nearest_existing_site: Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1
distinctness_review.identity_explanation: The existing No.1 row records Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1 LLC as operator and BroadBand Tower as tenant. Ishikari City separately lists Sakura Ishikari under Green Energy Data Center No.1 and the Tokyu/Flower/Agility project under Ishikari Renewable Energy Data Center No.1. They are different named properties and operators. The regional DCC consortium is a collaboration among multiple local businesses, not evidence of a shared campus or lease. Bounded primary review found no property-identity or Sakura-tenancy bridge requiring a merge.

review.independent_parent_visual_review: Parent independently identified the same perpendicular building pair, sports-hall circle, roads and northwest small compound; accepted approximate campus precision pending final packet.

excluded_inferences: No exact Building 3 C/D location or achieved fit-out status.
No inference that every campus building, container or planned phase is complete or operational.
No construction conclusion from map buildings or retrieval date.
No assertion about current ground surface, courtyard use, cadastral ownership extent or surveyed accuracy.
public_extract_note: Only factual coordinates, source identities, numeric tile calculation and hashes are projected into tracked JSON. Original source bytes and review images remain in ignored local_data.
